facts.business: Devyani International Limited is one of India's largest Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) operators and a key franchisee of Yum! Brands, operating KFC, Pizza Hut, and Costa Coffee, along with owned brands like Vaango and Food Street, and recently acquired brands Biryani by Kilo and Goila Butter Chicken.

segments.name: India - Own Brands (Vaango, Food Street, Biryani by Kilo, Goila Butter Chicken)

key_risks: Impairment assessment of territory and franchisee rights, brands, goodwill and other non-current assets
facts.related_party_note: Variance in trade receivables reported to banks vs books is mainly on account of receivable from related parties as accepted by Banks.
